trap.label: be ausente
trap.wrong: The error log should have checked by two people.
trap.right: The error log should have been checked by two people.
trap.why: Em português “deveria ter sido checado” tem duas partes; o aluno esquece o be. Em inglês, modal perfect passive = modal + have been + pp.

mcq.q: Active to passive: “They can test the fix.”
Focus on the **action**, not the actor:

fix.wrong: Errors must reported to the team.
fix.right: Errors must be reported to the team.
